shared.append_system_prompt: This project uses Rust 2024 edition. Run `cargo fmt` after changes. Use `thiserror` for library errors. All public APIs need doc comments. Conventional commits: `feat(claudes): ...`. Reference issue #380 in commits. Target branch for PR is `main`.

tasks.name: plan
tasks.prompt:
You are designing the implementation for issue #380 Phase 1: explicit skill injection and self-contained manifests.

First, assess what already exists in the codebase. Read these files thoroughly:
- crates/claudes/src/manifest.rs (Shared, Task structs, resolve(), resolve_files())
- crates/claudes/src/runner.rs (build_query_command())
- crates/claudes/src/cli.rs (RunArgs, PlanArgs)
- crates/claudes/src/planner.rs (PlanOptions, plan())
- crates/claudes/src/main.rs (how CLI args map to execution)

Phase 1 requirements from the issue:
1. `skills` field on Shared and Task (list of file paths) — resolved at manifest load, appended to system prompt
2. `--skill` CLI flag on `claudes run`
3. `settings` field (string path) on Shared and Task — maps to `--settings` on claude CLI
4. `setting_sources` field (string) on Shared and Task — maps to `--setting-sources` on claude CLI

For each requirement, determine:
- Is it already implemented? If so, note the line numbers.
- What's missing or incomplete?
- What files need changes and what those changes are?

Write a detailed implementation plan to your breadcrumb. Include:
- Exact files to modify and what to add/change in each
- Field names, types, serde attributes
- How settings/setting_sources flow through resolve() and into build_query_command()
- Any new QueryCommand methods needed in claude-wrapper

Do NOT modify any files. Research only.

tasks.name: code
tasks.prompt:
Read the breadcrumb from the plan task for the implementation plan.

Implement issue #380 Phase 1. The breadcrumb tells you exactly what exists and what's missing. Follow it closely.

Key files you may modify:
- crates/claudes/src/manifest.rs — Add missing fields to Shared/Task, update resolve(), resolve_files(), TaskBuilder, serde
- crates/claudes/src/runner.rs — Update build_query_command() to pass new fields to QueryCommand
- crates/claudes/src/cli.rs — Add any missing CLI flags (--skill, --settings, --setting-sources)
- crates/claudes/src/planner.rs — Add new fields to PlanOptions/PlanOptionsBuilder, wire into plan()
- crates/claudes/src/main.rs — Wire new CLI args into manifest/shared block
- src/command/query.rs — Add settings/setting_sources methods if they don't exist on QueryCommand
- src/types.rs — Add any new types if needed

Do NOT modify test files — the next task handles that.
Do NOT create a commit.

After making changes, run:
- cargo fmt --all
- cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
- cargo test --lib --all-features

Fix any errors before finishing.

tasks.name: review
tasks.prompt:
Read the breadcrumbs from plan and code tasks.

Review and test the implementation of issue #380 Phase 1.

1. Read all modified files and verify:
   - Fields are correctly added with proper serde attributes (skip_serializing_if, default)
   - resolve() merges settings/setting_sources with correct precedence (task > profile > shared)
   - resolve_files() handles skill loading correctly
   - build_query_command() passes new fields to QueryCommand
   - CLI flags are wired through to the shared block
   - Doc comments on all public fields/methods

2. Add tests in crates/claudes/src/manifest.rs (in the existing #[cfg(test)] module):
   - settings and setting_sources resolve with correct precedence
   - settings and setting_sources appear in serialized manifest
   - settings passthrough in build_query_command (if testable at unit level)
   - Any edge cases the plan identified

3. Run the full test suite:
   - cargo test --lib --all-features
   - cargo test --doc --all-features
   - cargo doc --no-deps --all-features

4. Fix any issues you find — both in the implementation and tests.

Do NOT create a commit.

Files you may modify:
- crates/claudes/src/manifest.rs (tests + any fixes)
- crates/claudes/src/runner.rs (fixes only)
- crates/claudes/src/cli.rs (fixes only)
- crates/claudes/src/main.rs (fixes only)
- src/command/query.rs (fixes only)

tasks.name: pr
tasks.prompt:
Read the breadcrumbs from all previous tasks.

Create a commit and PR for issue #380 Phase 1.

1. Stage all changed files (use `git add` with specific file paths, not `git add -A`).
2. Create a commit:
   feat(claudes): explicit skill injection and settings passthrough (#380)
3. Push the branch.
4. Create a PR with `gh pr create`:
   - Title: feat(claudes): explicit skill injection and settings passthrough (#380)
   - Body: Summary of what was added (skills field, --skill CLI, settings/setting_sources passthrough), link to #380, test plan
   - Base branch: main

Do NOT merge the PR.
Do NOT add Co-Authored-By lines.
Do NOT include 'Generated with Claude Code' in the PR body.
